screens.name: Hero
screens.html:
Swift Design

Designs from HTML, written by your agent.
screens.css: .s1-hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42fr 58fr; height: 100%; } .s1-panel { background: var(--accent); } .s1-copy { align-self: center; padding: 0 72px; } h1 { font-size: 90px; font-weight: 700; } .s1-caption { font-size: 30px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 18px; }

screens.name: What it does
screens.html:
What Swift Design does

  • Agents read the schema and write design JSON.
  • The server validates and renders every screen.
  • The user edits screens in the browser.
screens.css: .s2-page { padding: 72px 90px; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } h2 { font-size: 54px; font-weight: 600; } .s2-rule { width: 120px; height: 6px; background: var(--accent); margin: 21px 0 36px; } .s2-columns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr; gap: 72px; align-items: start; } .s2-columns li { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 15px; } .s2-columns img { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; }
